run_ml_neb_validation: run a validation of the ML NEB model on a set of NEB calculations using DyNEB and BFGS optimizer
get_results_ml: get the percent success and convergence for the ML model using only ML energy and force calls
get_results_sp: get the percent success and convergence for the model with single points performed on transition states
parse_neb_info: process ML NEB results and extract barrier height, reaction energy, convergence status, and transition state index
get_single_point: get a single point energy and forces on atoms using VASP interactive calculator
